jobs.description:

Job Description:

We are seeking a highly strategic, technically grounded, and seasoned Senior Program Manager to lead and scale our Global Professional Services Channel Program . In this role, you will be responsible for designing, deploying, and governing the expert advantage professional services programs that enable our channel partners to successfully deliver and activate complex enterprise solutions.
The ideal candidate will possess an extensive background in channel program architecture, a deep understanding of ecosystem routes to market, and a solid technical grasp of multi-cloud infrastructure—specifically the VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) platform and its core components (Storage, Kubernetes, and Security). You must be an exceptional content creator, cross-functional diplomat, and master communicator capable of driving thought leadership, thinking creatively outside traditional programmatic boundaries, and navigating matrixed environments with cross functional stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

1. Channel Program Strategy & Expert Advantage Program Management
- Lead and evolve the Expert Advantage Program , a flagship initiative dedicated to empowering, incentivizing, and accelerating the growth of our specialized consulting services partners globally.
- Design customized partner benefits and tailored value propositions that align with diverse partner business models, ensuring partners clearly recognize and capture measurable value from the program.
- Design and execute comprehensive, global professional services channel programs tailored to drive partner-led delivery, service activation, and customer consumption.
- Optimize and govern various aspects of the program to ensure partner profitability, service quality, and alignment with strategic goals.
- Collaborate with Product and Global Services teams to translate complex technical roadmaps into structured partner enablement and delivery frameworks.

2. Services Delivery & Technical Ecosystem Adoption
- Act as the programmatic champion for the delivery and activation of VMware solutions, with a primary focus on the VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) platform.
- Drive partner adoption and delivery readiness across critical technology pillars, including software-defined storage, container orchestration (Kubernetes), and advanced cloud security components.
- Optimize the entitlement process by leveraging existing tools to make it more efficient.
- Architect and author high-impact content , core program messaging, and critical enablement assets (e.g., playbooks, value proposition decks, program guides, and whitepapers) tailored for both internal execution and external partner activation.
- Translate complex programmatic rules and technical solutions into compelling, easy-to-digest business narratives.

3. Partner Certifications & Entitlement Management
- Build on structure and evolution of partner certification blueprints, technical validation pathways, and competency requirements globally as relates to the expert advantage program.
- Manage and untangle complex customer entitlement frameworks with a focus on our commercial segment , ensuring partners can seamlessly navigate licensing, deployment rights, and service credits to accelerate time-to-value.

4. Data Analytics, Third-Party Tools & Operational Execution
- Establish, monitor, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) and operational metrics to evaluate global program health, partner performance, and ROI.
- Provide thought leadership to internal executive teams and external partner leaders, presenting clear, data-driven programmatic strategies.
- Navigate and influence a high-energy corporate culture with diverse, strong personalities by building consensus and driving alignment across regional and global teams.
- Leverage and navigate diverse third-party tools and enterprise platforms to extract, analyze, and synthesize raw data outputs into structured, highly actionable operational execution plans.

5. Cross-Functional Collaboration, Advisory Boards & Events
- Partner closely with Pre-Sales and Professional Services Organizations (PSO) to establish, cultivate, and lead global Services Advisory Boards , capturing partner feedback to influence long-term corporate strategy.
- Drive thought leadership and end-to-end execution of services engagement events globally, positioning our organization as a premier services enablement engine for partners.
- Act as the strategic bridge between technical pre-sales engineering, field delivery teams, marketing and partner ecosystems to ensure cohesive global messaging and programmatic alignment.

Required Qualifications
- Education: Required to hold both a Bachelor’s degree (in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field) AND or a Master’s degree (MBA or Master of Science in a relevant discipline).
- Experience: Minimum of 15 years of progressive industry experience within the enterprise software, cloud infrastructure, or technology sector, with a definitive focus on Channel Program Management and Professional Services .
- Tools & Analytical Skills: Advanced data literacy with a proven ability to work with third-party applications/tools and extract raw metrics to drive strategic program execution. Strong proficiency in building executive-level reports, dashboards, and consumption metrics .
- VMware Domain Expertise: Strong working knowledge of VMware technologies, specifically the VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) platform architecture and its component stacks (including vSAN/Storage, Tanzu/Kubernetes, and NSX/Security).
- Program & Business Acumen: Direct experience structuring partner certification requirements, managing global routes to market, and operationalizing customer entitlement models. Experience with AI models and output preferred.
- Global Scale: Proven track record of managing programs across multiple geographies (AMER, EMEA, APJ) while accounting for regional market nuances.

Preferred Soft Skills & Attributes
- Innovative & "Outside-the-Box" Thinking: Proven ability to look past legacy programmatic frameworks to design non-traditional workflows, creative incentive structures, and novel problem-solving methodologies. You don't just manage existing programs; you re-imagine them to solve complex global channel friction.
- High Emotional Intelligence (EQ): Proven ability to challenge the status quo, handle strong personalities, and command respect through competence and diplomatic communication.
- Communication Excellence: Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to distill highly technical concepts or dense programmatic data into clear business value for executive-level audiences.

Compensation and Benefits

The On Target Earnings (OTE) range for this position is USD 129,400.00 To USD 207,000.00

OTE includes Sales Incentive Commission in accordance with relevant plan documents and salary. In addition, as a valued member of our team, you'll be eligible to receive a competitive new hire equity grant and annual equity awards, directly connecting your success to the company's growth. All subject to relevant plan documents and award agreements.

Broadcom offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package:  Medical, dental and vision plans, 401(K) participation including company matching, Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), company paid holidays, paid sick leave and vacation time. The company follows all applicable laws for Paid Family Leave and other leaves of absence.

Job Description:

Job Overview
The APAC Cloud Transformation Office is seeking an Advisory Strategist to drive Broadcom’s Infrastructure Software Group (ISG) portfolio across our highest-value enterprise accounts in Japan and the broader APAC region.

Operating with a startup mindset and broad-spectrum ownership, this role bridges executive strategy, deep technical execution, and financial engineering. Reporting to the APAC Advisory Leader, you will act as a trusted industry authority who connects complex technology investments directly to board-level business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities
- Executive Advisory: Balance top-tier executive advisory with a strong technical mindset—moving seamlessly between C-suite strategy roundtables and architectural deep-dives.
- Business-to-Technology Alignment: Trace and connect complex infrastructure and platform architectures directly to enterprise revenue growth, risk reduction, and operational efficiency.
- Startup Ownership: Thrive in challenging, ambiguous, and high-stakes environments by taking end-to-end, broad-spectrum ownership to drive projects past corporate inertia.
- Domain Strategy Execution: Lead strategic client engagements focused on AI/Generative AI infrastructure, datacentre modernization enterprise cloud security, or proven operational leadership within top tier enterprises.

Target Expertise & Domain Expertise

- Cyber security & resiliency: Enterprise security frameworks, zero-trust architectures, governance, and cloud compliance.

- 10+ years in technology strategy, architectural advisory, or management consulting, with a demonstrated ability to translate technical capabilities into quantifiable ROI.

Job Description:

Staff Program Manager – Advanced Packaging Technology

Overview
The Staff Program Manager will manage one or more very large scale Advanced Packaging manufacturing projects, through the entire lifecycle from greenfield factory construction, to tool procurement, and all the way to production ramp. Extensive collaboration is required with all stakeholders (R&D and Factory Teams, internal Project Team members & executives, Partners, EPC Contractor and Tool Vendors worldwide) to achieve all project milestones on schedule and within budget, with proven yield and quality in production

Key Responsibilities
Technology Development and Transfer for Production
•    Achieve on time Technology Qualification, through collaborate with in-house and partner R&D teams developing disruptive technologies.
•    Facilitate successful Technology Transfer from R&D into High Volume Manufacturing (HVM)
Factory Construction
•    Coordinate greenfield construction of a very large scale advanced packaging manufacturing facility
•    Manage the EPC contractor and other local architectural, engineering, and sub- contractor firms to ensure strict timeline and safety compliance.
•    Oversee compliance with local codes / requirements for land development, civil engineering, cleanroom construction, and facility hook-up.
•    Report program status, budget variances, and milestone achievements directly to executive leadership.
Tool Procurement & Integration
•    Work with Factory and R&D Teams on Tool selection, procurement, logistics, and installation of next generation equipment for Heterogeneous Integration from global tier-one vendors
•    Coordinate complex international logistics to import highly sensitive tooling and materials
•    Oversee the hook-up, facility integration, and initial hardware qualification of all manufacturing lines.
Production Ramp & Yield Optimization
•    Partner with Factory & R&D teams and Tool vendors, for operational transition from tool qualification to HVM readiness
•    Accelerate yield learning curves and meet target defect-density metrics in collaboration with process engineering and quality teams
•    Manage manufacturing cycle time, line balancing, and factory automation deployment during the ramp phase.
•    Establish standard operating procedures (SOPs) and training pipelines to upscale the local workforce for stable production.
Financial & Local Regulatory Compliance
•    Manage multi-billion-dollar CapEx and OpEx budgets and cash flows, in collaboration with Finance teams.
•    Ensure compliance with local Regulatory Agency requirements
•    Implement strict risk-mitigation frameworks to handle supply chain bottlenecks and labor market constraints.

Required Qualifications
Education & Experience
•    Education: Master’s degree in Engineering, Materials Science, or related STEM field. MBA preferred.
•    Experience: 6+ years managing very large projects, with explicit experience in greenfield factory construction and factory ramps.
•    Domain: Deep technical understanding of advanced packaging and semiconductor manufacturing technologies (Heterogeneous Integration, Substrates, Co-packaged Optics).
•    Ramp Expertise: Proven track record transitioning a semiconductor facility from construction to high-volume production.
•    Geography: Foundational knowledge of delivering large-scale offshore industrial projects

Skills & Certifications
•    Certifications: PMP, PgMP, or equivalent senior-level project management credentials.
•    Operations: Strong grasp of factory physics, statistical process control (SPC), yield management, and Lean manufacturing.
•    Supply Chain: Expertise in managing global semiconductor tool and material vendors.
•    Software: Advanced mastery of enterprise scheduling tools (e.g., Primavera P6, MS Project).
•    Soft Skills: Exceptional stakeholder management skills for navigating dynamically changing business and product requirements

Additional Job Description:

Job Description:

The System Level Test Program Manager owns SLT program execution for multiple concurrent XPU customer programs across a distributed US-Asia footprint, balancing real-time program delivery with technical innovation. This role combines program management accountability (schedule, yield, cost), on-site production leadership (partnering with Asia test operations), and a technical engineering depth (test methodology and equipment evaluation). Success requires customer management, relentless prioritization under pressure, cross-timezone coordination, and occasional travel to Asia production sites.

Key Responsibilities

Program Management & Multi-Customer Execution
• Own end-to-end SLT execution for multiple concurrent XPU programs through silicon bring-up, production ramp, and sustained 100% volume operations
• Drive weekly program status, risk tracking, and customer commitments; escalate blockers to Senior Management within 24 hours with recommended mitigation
• Translate customer test specifications, quality gates, and margining requirements into actionable SLT plans; own electrical test coverage sign-off and escape rate targets
• Manage portfolio prioritization when programs compete for resources (equipment, site capacity, engineer time); present trade-off options and risks to director for conflict resolution
• Conduct customer program reviews, status updates, and escalation communication; own SLT portion of customer commitments

Production Operations & Asia Site Leadership
• Travel to Asia production sites couple times a year to manage test floor execution, resolve operational blockers, and ensure quality/schedule adherence
• Forecast SLT capacity requirements, drive equipment utilization optimization, and manage shift planning across US R&D and Asia production sites
• Partner with Ops manager on sustained production operations
• Establish SLT quality gates, data integrity audits, and escalation protocols for Asia production sites
• Drive equipment maintenance scheduling, spare parts inventory management, and tooling readiness to maximize SLT test floor uptime and minimize operational downtime

Test Methodology & Equipment Innovation
• Evaluate and pilot new test techniques (advanced margining, Vmin stress, multi-site protocols) in partnership with Design/DFT teams
• Lead transition of new test methodologies from R&D (US) to production (Asia); drive pilot design, runoff, and full deployment
• Influence ATE equipment roadmap and automation tooling; assess new equipment investments and ROI for SLT operations
• Mentor engineers on advanced test methodologies and drive capability growth in distributed team
• Contribute to post-silicon debug and yield correlation analysis; own SLT test-related root cause investigations

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Risk Management
• Identify, track, and prioritize risks across schedule, yield, capacity, and equipment; assess risk working with owners and target closure
• Lead root-cause analysis on yield misses, test escapes, and schedule delays; own corrective action closure and prevention planning
• Partner with Design/DFT on testability and early-silicon yield correlation; surface test bottlenecks before they cascade
• Coordinate with Manufacturing and Logistics on device staging, test scheduling, and shipment readiness
• Work with Quality/Reliability on escape analysis and early-life failure investigation
• Drive SLT yield improvement initiatives and Defective Parts Per Million (DPPM) reduction targets by partnering with test, design, and manufacturing teams to drive continuous quality enhancements

Required Qualifications
• Bachelors and 12+ years of related experience
• 9+ years in semiconductor test engineering or test operations (SLT, probe test, or production test)
• 3–5 years in program or operations leadership (with schedule, cost, or quality accountability)
• Hands-on expertise in ATE programming, test methodology, yield debugging, and SLT tool flows
• Demonstrated success shipping 2+ high-volume programs from silicon bring-up through ramp
• Experience working with cross-geographic or distributed teams; comfort with asynchronous collaboration and time zone management
• Strong project management discipline: risk tracking, escalation, forecasting, decision documentation
• Proficiency with test data analysis, yield correlation, and statistical methods
• Willingness and ability to travel internationally (Asia production sites)
• Excellent communication skills with engineers, operations teams, customers, and leadership

Preferred Qualifications
• Deep experience with XPU, high-performance computing, or networking ASICs
• Familiarity with 3nm or advanced process nodes
• Background in hyperscaler or cloud customer environments (understanding urgency and risk tolerance)
• Track record evaluating and implementing new test technologies or ATE equipment
• Experience with advanced test techniques (margining, Vmin, in-circuit stress, multi-site)
• On-site production operations or factory management experience
• Exposure to offshore team management or time zone span management
• Knowledge of test software stacks and automation frameworks
• Basic Six Sigma or process improvement certification

Compensation and Benefits

The annual base salary range for this position is USD 129,400.00 To USD 207,000.00

As a valued member of our team, you'll be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus and the opportunity to receive not only a competitive new hire equity grant, but also annual equity awards, connecting your success directly to the company's growth. Your expertise in the payment security industry, particularly in 3D Secure, will be critical in driving client satisfaction and maintaining our reputation as a trusted partner.

Job Description:

As the  License Compliance Manager for China , you will be responsible for protecting the company’s intellectual property (IP) and transforming non-compliant software usage into a strategic revenue driver.

Unlike traditional enforcement-only roles, this position requires a commercial, data-driven professional who can leverage license compliance data to identify business opportunities, drive incremental revenue recovery, and upsell legitimate solutions to corporate customers in China. You will collaborate closely with local Sales, Legal, and Channel Partner teams to convert compliance infractions into positive, long-term commercial relationships.

Key Responsibilities
1. Revenue Recovery & Commercial Conversion
- Drive Incremental Business:  Analyze telemetry and compliance data to identify unauthorized software usage within corporate accounts, converting these leads into net-new sales opportunities.
- Pipeline Management:  Own the compliance revenue pipeline for China, tracking engagement from initial detection to final commercial resolution.
- Customer Negotiation:  Lead commercial negotiations with non-compliant organizations, guiding them toward legalization through structured, value-driven sales conversations rather than purely legal escalation.

2. Strategy & Market Customization
- China-Specific Compliance Strategy:  Develop and execute a localized compliance strategy tailored to the unique legal landscape, business culture, and enforcement mechanisms in China.
- Anti-Piracy Initiatives:  Collaborate with local industry associations, legal counsel, and government bodies where necessary to support IP protection initiatives.
- Channel Partner Alignment:  Work with local resellers to ensure they are equipped to handle compliance-generated leads and convert them into standard commercial accounts.

3. Data Analytics & Audit Management
- Audit Execution:  Manage soft-audits and formal review processes with corporate clients, ensuring a professional, consultative approach that preserves the brand's reputation.
- Data Utilization:  Leverage internal telemetry tools and external data sources to map out high-value compliance targets and prioritize accounts with the highest revenue potential.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
- ABV Recovered:  Direct revenue generated via license compliance conversions.
- Conversion Rate:  Percentage of non-compliant accounts successfully converted to legal, paying customers.
- Pipeline Velocity:  Time taken from identifying an infraction to closing the legalization sale.

Qualifications & Experience
Education & Experience
- Bachelor’s Degree  in Business, Law, Information Technology, or a related field.
- 12+ years of experience  in License Compliance, Software Asset Management (SAM), Inside Sales, or Software Business Development within the China market.
- Proven track record of  meeting or exceeding revenue targets  through compliance or complex commercial negotiations.

Skills & Competencies
- Commercial Mindset:  Ability to balance legal IP rights with business acumen, treating compliance as a customer acquisition channel.
- Strong Negotiation:  Exceptional communication skills with the ability to handle high-stakes, sensitive negotiations with C-level executives in Chinese enterprises.
- Local Market Expertise:  Deep understanding of the software purchasing ecosystem, local business etiquette, and IP law frameworks in China.
- Language:  Native fluency in  Mandarin  and professional proficiency in  English  are required.
